items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 26th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 77 while the rest average 31 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 77/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 5.73M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-09-23: 35 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 5.73M SPX, 5.8σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 35 wallets left 5.73M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.
